title: 花開富貴: gold-keyline moth and peony on xuan

techniques.name: Keyline assembly

weight.label: Line weight
weight.note: Weight of every line the figure draws, as a multiple of its own.

bleed.label: Ink bleed
bleed.note: How far the page lets each ink wander off its edge (the displacement in its ink filter), as a multiple of its own. 0 prints a clean edge.

tooth.label: Paper tooth
tooth.note: Opacity of the paper texture multiplied over the plate. 0 is a smooth sheet.

type.label: Type size
type.note: Size of every label the figure sets.

seed.label: Seed
seed.note: Re-rolls every seeded choice the page makes: the paper, grain, dust and the ink filters’ noise. 0 is the page’s own print.

techniques.implementation: Type, a botanical figure and a frame assembled into one sheet in three or four inks. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
